column2:
vacancy(n.)空缺、空房、空位
vacant(adj.)空的、未被占用的
job vacancy 職缺
no vacancy 客滿
The company has several job vacancies for engineers.
(那家公司有幾個工程師的職缺。)
We drove past three hotels with 'No Vacancy' signs.
(我們開車經過三家掛著「客滿」牌子的旅館。)

vain(adj.)徒勞的、自負的、愛慕虛榮的
vanity(n.)虛榮心
in vain 徒勞無功
vain attempt 徒勞的嘗試
He tried in vain to fix the broken printer.
(他試著修理壞掉的印表機，卻徒勞無功。)
She is so vain that she checks the mirror every few minutes.
(她很愛慕虛榮，每隔幾分鐘就照一次鏡子。)

vast(adj.)廣大的、巨大的、大量的
vastly(adv.)大大地、極其
vast majority 絕大多數
vast area 廣大的地區
The vast majority of students passed the exam.
(絕大多數學生都通過了考試。)
The Sahara Desert covers a vast area of North Africa.
(撒哈拉沙漠覆蓋北非廣大的地區。)

vegetarian(n.)素食者
vegetable(n.)蔬菜
vegetarian food 素食
strict vegetarian 嚴格的素食者
My aunt has been a vegetarian for over ten years.
(我阿姨吃素已經超過十年了。)
There are many vegetarian restaurants in Taipei.
(台北有很多素食餐廳。)

vessel(n.)船、容器、血管
(無詞性變化)
blood vessel 血管
fishing vessel 漁船
Blood vessels carry blood around the body.
(血管將血液輸送到全身。)
Several fishing vessels returned to the harbor before the typhoon.
(颱風來臨前，好幾艘漁船返回了港口。)

violate(v.)違反、侵犯
violation(n.)違反、侵犯
violator(n.)違反者
violate the law 違法
violate someone's privacy 侵犯某人隱私
Posting someone's photo without permission may violate their privacy.
(未經允許張貼別人的照片可能侵犯其隱私。)
Drivers who violate traffic rules will be fined.
(違反交通規則的駕駛人會被罰款。)

violation(n.)違反、侵犯
violate(v.)違反、侵犯
traffic violation 交通違規
human rights violation 侵犯人權
He got a ticket for a traffic violation.
(他因交通違規收到一張罰單。)
Copying others' work is a violation of school rules.
(抄襲別人的作品違反校規。)

virtue(n.)美德、優點
virtuous(adj.)有道德的
by virtue of 由於、憑藉
patience is a virtue 耐心是一種美德
Honesty is an important virtue.
(誠實是一項重要的美德。)
One virtue of this phone is its long battery life.
(這支手機的一大優點是電池續航力長。)

virus(n.)病毒、電腦病毒
viral(adj.)病毒的、(網路上)爆紅的
computer virus 電腦病毒
spread a virus 散播病毒
The virus spread quickly around the world.
(這種病毒很快就傳遍全世界。)
Don't open that file; it may contain a computer virus.
(不要打開那個檔案，它可能含有電腦病毒。)

visual(adj.)視覺的
visualize(v.)想像、使視覺化
visually(adv.)視覺上
visual arts 視覺藝術
visual aid 視覺輔助教具
The teacher used visual aids to explain the lesson.
(老師使用視覺輔助教具講解這一課。)
She is interested in studying visual arts in college.
(她有興趣在大學念視覺藝術。)

vital(adj.)極重要的、生命的、充滿活力的
vitality(n.)活力
vital role 極重要的角色
vital signs 生命徵象
Sleep plays a vital role in our health.
(睡眠對我們的健康扮演極重要的角色。)
It is vital that you follow the safety rules.
(你務必要遵守安全規定。)

voluntary(adj.)自願的、義務的
volunteer(n./v.)志工、自願
voluntarily(adv.)自願地
voluntary work 志願服務工作
on a voluntary basis 以自願的方式
Joining the cleaning team is voluntary.
(加入打掃隊是自願的。)
She does voluntary work at the animal shelter every weekend.
(她每個週末都在動物收容所做志工。)

volunteer(n./v.)志工、自願者、自願
voluntary(adj.)自願的
volunteer work 志工服務
volunteer to 自願做…
Many students volunteer at the library after school.
(很多學生放學後在圖書館當志工。)
Tom volunteered to clean the classroom.
(湯姆自願打掃教室。)

voyage(n./v.)航行、旅程、航海
(無詞性變化)
maiden voyage 首航
sea voyage 海上航行
The Titanic sank on its maiden voyage.
(鐵達尼號在首航時沉沒了。)
The sailors voyaged across the Pacific Ocean.
(水手們航行橫越太平洋。)

waken(v.)喚醒、醒來
wake(v.)醒來、叫醒
awaken(v.)喚醒、喚起
waken someone up 叫醒某人
be wakened by 被…吵醒
I was wakened by the sound of rain.
(我被雨聲吵醒了。)
Please don't waken the baby; she just fell asleep.
(請不要吵醒寶寶，她剛睡著。)

website(n.)網站
(無詞性變化)
official website 官方網站
visit a website 瀏覽網站
You can find more information on the school's official website.
(你可以在學校官方網站上找到更多資訊。)
This website offers free English lessons.
(這個網站提供免費的英文課程。)

welfare(n.)福利、福祉
(無詞性變化)
social welfare 社會福利
animal welfare 動物福利
The government should improve social welfare for the elderly.
(政府應該改善老年人的社會福利。)
She cares a lot about animal welfare.
(她非常關心動物福利。)

wink(n./v.)眨眼、使眼色
(無詞性變化)
wink at 對…眨眼示意
not sleep a wink 一夜沒闔眼
He winked at me to show it was a joke.
(他對我眨眼，表示那只是個玩笑。)
I didn't sleep a wink before the exam.
(考試前我整晚都沒闔眼。)

wit(n.)機智、風趣、智力
witty(adj.)機智的、風趣的
quick wit 反應機敏
at one's wits' end 不知所措
Everyone loves him for his quick wit.
(大家都喜歡他反應機敏又風趣。)
I'm at my wits' end with this math problem.
(這道數學題讓我束手無策。)

witch(n.)女巫
wizard(n.)男巫、奇才
witch hunt 政治迫害、獵巫
computer wizard 電腦奇才
In the story, a witch turned the prince into a frog.
(故事中，一位女巫把王子變成了青蛙。)
Harry Potter is a young wizard who studies at Hogwarts.
(哈利波特是一位在霍格華茲就讀的年輕巫師。)

withdraw(v.)提(款)、撤回、退出
withdrawal(n.)提款、撤退、退出
withdraw money 提款
withdraw from 退出…
I need to withdraw some money from the ATM.
(我需要從提款機領一些錢。)
He withdrew from the race because of an injury.
(他因受傷退出比賽。)

witness(n./v.)目擊者、證人、目擊、見證
(無詞性變化)
key witness 關鍵證人
witness an accident 目擊事故
The police are looking for witnesses to the car accident.
(警方正在尋找那起車禍的目擊者。)
We witnessed a beautiful sunrise from the top of Alishan.
(我們在阿里山上見證了美麗的日出。)

workout(n.)運動、鍛鍊
work out(v.)運動、健身、解決
daily workout 每日運動
intense workout 高強度鍛鍊
A 30-minute workout every day keeps me healthy.
(每天運動三十分鐘讓我保持健康。)
I felt tired but happy after the workout.
(運動完後我覺得疲累但很開心。)

workplace(n.)工作場所、職場
(無詞性變化)
in the workplace 在職場上
workplace safety 職場安全
Good communication skills are important in the workplace.
(良好的溝通能力在職場上很重要。)
The company pays close attention to workplace safety.
(那家公司非常重視職場安全。)

wreck(n./v.)殘骸、失事、毀壞、破壞
wreckage(n.)殘骸
shipwreck 船難
a nervous wreck 神經緊繃的人
Divers found the wreck of an old ship on the seabed.
(潛水員在海底發現一艘古老船隻的殘骸。)
The storm wrecked many houses near the coast.
(暴風雨摧毀了海岸附近的許多房子。)

yawn(n./v.)打哈欠、呵欠
(無詞性變化)
give a yawn 打個哈欠
stifle a yawn 忍住哈欠
He yawned several times during the long meeting.
(在冗長的會議中他打了好幾個哈欠。)
Yawning is contagious; when one person yawns, others often do too.
(打哈欠會傳染，一個人打哈欠時，別人常常也會跟著打。)

youthful(adj.)年輕的、有朝氣的
youth(n.)青春、年輕人
youthful energy 青春活力
youthful appearance 年輕的外表
My grandmother still looks youthful at seventy.
(我奶奶七十歲了看起來仍然很年輕。)
The students' youthful energy filled the classroom.
(學生們的青春活力充滿了整間教室。)
